project: Dante, a sales agent for a print shop
scope: One thin vertical, end to end, over the business cards family. All on Telegram. WhatsApp, email and billing are out of scope.
language_rule: Everything in English: code, identifiers, docs, commits, tickets. The only Spanish is what a customer reads.

team.name: Fede
team.focus: Chassis, channel, turn, orders and deposit

team.name: All four
team.focus: Integration, evals, shadow mode and demo

milestones.milestone: Contracts frozen. All four compile against the same types.
The demo walks end to end.

tasks.title: Service chassis
tasks.description: Repo with bun and Mastra, a bun Dockerfile, fly.toml with a volume and min_machines_running at 1, healthcheck. Seeded from the sergio-mastra precedent, which is already single tenant with one webhook channel and LibSQL on a volume.
acceptance_criteria: fly deploy finishes and GET /health returns 200
bun test and bun run typecheck run and pass with zero tests
The volume keeps a file across two consecutive deploys

tasks.title: Domain contracts
tasks.description: src/domain/types.ts with Intent, Resolution, PriceEdit, Unit, OrderState and EscalationReason. Every enum is an as const array that generates both the union type and the SQLite CHECK from one source. Critical path: blocks lanes B, C and D.
acceptance_criteria: All four lanes import from this file and compile
A helper generates the SQLite CHECK from the as const array, with a test
Zero client constants in the file
Delivered before H+2

tasks.title: Schema and storage seam
tasks.description: Idempotent inline DDL over LibSQL for families, items, facts, orders, price_edits and price_versions. Litestream replicating to a bucket from the first deploy, not when there is data worth losing.
acceptance_criteria: The DDL runs twice in a row without error
items has a unique constraint over family plus attribute bag plus tier
unit exists on families as a default and on items as an override
Litestream replicates and a test restore brings the database back

tasks.title: Telegram bot with two roles
tasks.description: One bot, two roles. The admin role is for the four of us and the customer role simulates the prospect. Update dedupe copied from the precedent.
acceptance_criteria: A repeated Telegram update does not fire two replies
The role comes from the sender, not from a command the user picks
An incoming message is recorded with its conversation id

tasks.title: Three phase conversation turn
tasks.description: Orchestration: extraction with structuredOutput and no tools over already fenced text, resolution with SQL plus priceFor, writing with the amount injected as data. The agent has no tools.
acceptance_criteria: The writing model receives the computed amount and cannot alter it
The resolution phase calls no model
Every missing attribute is asked in one message, and anything still missing is asked one at a time
A test covers the full turn with a model double

tasks.title: Dante persona and caps
tasks.description: A third PersonaKind, agent, which requires disclosure instead of forbidding it. Neutral rioplatense voseo. Persona first, caps second, never the other way around.
acceptance_criteria: Introduces itself as automated in one line in the first message of every new conversation and never again in that conversation
Caps compose after the persona, verified by a test over the assembled prompt
Only states amounts that arrived as data in the turn
Never names the C invoice

tasks.title: Orders with a copied amount
tasks.description: orders with the states quoted, deposit_pending, deposit_confirmed, files_ok and in_production. The order copies the price instead of pointing at it: the one place in the system where copying data is correct.
acceptance_criteria: A test edits the list after quoting and the order keeps the old amount
A person moves the state from Telegram, never the agent alone
A quote is valid for 15 days and the expiry is stored, not computed from today at read time

tasks.title: Deposit by alias with human confirmation
tasks.description: Dante asks for the deposit by Mercado Pago alias, half the total at minimum. The receipt the customer sends is attached to the order. Any of the four can confirm, and the record says who did.
acceptance_criteria: The receipt is stored and never shown to whoever confirms
Who confirmed and when is on the record
An unconfirmed deposit never advances to in_production, with a test
If nobody confirms within two business hours the order enters the team inbox

tasks.title: Escalation to a person
tasks.description: When resolution returns escalate, the conversation moves to a human with a context note and Dante stops writing in that thread for good.
acceptance_criteria: After escalating, a new customer message produces no agent reply
The context note carries the escalation reason and what the customer asked for
All six EscalationReason values trigger escalation, each with its own test

tasks.title: Price list parser
tasks.description: Deterministic parser over lista-precios.html, which already comes structured as tables with classes: td.p for prices and tr.mod for add-ons and discounts. No vision pipeline for the initial load.
acceptance_criteria: Two runs produce byte identical JSON
It tells sale price, add-on and discount apart
A row matching no pattern fails loudly instead of being skipped silently

tasks.title: Diff the parse against the list
tasks.description: Before loading, the parser output is diffed against the original list. The HTML becomes the source of truth for the initial catalog and is already versioned in git.
acceptance_criteria: The diff is read row by row and signed off before loading
Added, removed and changed rows are shown separately
Zero unexplained differences in the business cards family

tasks.title: Seed the business cards family
tasks.description: Load cards into families and items. The family declares key, name, unit, module size, and the ordered list of attributes a quote needs before it can resolve.
acceptance_criteria: Card rows are in items with their unit and tier
The seed is idempotent: running it twice does not duplicate rows
The required attributes for cards are declared and ordered

tasks.title: priceFor, a pure function
tasks.description: Resolution without a model. Exact match or escalate: zero rows, more than one, or a missing attribute we already asked for returns escalate. No interpolation, no nearest neighbor, no roughly.
acceptance_criteria: It is a pure function with no network and no clock access
Each of the three escalation cases has its own test
It returns the itemId the amount came from and an explanation a human can read
The square meter versus linear meter rule is covered

tasks.title: Module math
tasks.description: A size that is not in the list does not escalate, it gets computed. Formula pending client confirmation: modules equals ceil of piece area over module area. It deliberately loosens the rule that the bot only repeats a number the owner typed.
acceptance_criteria: Card 15x5 gives 2 modules, large card 10x15 gives 4, A4 flyer gives 5
The message says how it got the number, so a human can catch the error by reading
Every input to the formula is data the owner typed
The no module discount assumption is flagged in docs/assumptions.md

tasks.title: VAT included, one final number
tasks.description: Dante quotes list plus 21%, as one final number. Never plus VAT, never the bare price. Rate in config, not in the code.
acceptance_criteria: No amount leaves the engine without VAT, with a test
The rate is read from config
A question about whether VAT is mandatory returns escalate with reason vat_question

tasks.title: Facts and their fenced injection
tasks.description: A facts table with addresses, hours, phones, delivery times per family, payment methods, what the shop does and does not do. Injected into the turn as fenced data. One cap: what is not in that block, you do not know.
acceptance_criteria: A question about an unloaded fact returns escalate, not a plausible answer
The facts block enters fenced as untrusted
Hours and payment methods confirmed on 2026-09-10 are loaded
Missing facts sit as pending data and that escalates

tasks.title: Ten business card pricing cases
tasks.description: Ten cases per loaded family, not ten in total. They come from real conversations, with what the human answered. A family without tests does not ship.
acceptance_criteria: bun test green
Zero prices outside the catalog, which is the governing metric
Includes module math and the linear meter versus square meter rule
Each case names the real conversation it came from

tasks.title: Escalation rate by family
tasks.description: Measured from day one. It will be high at the start and it is the honest signal of catalog coverage, not a failure.
acceptance_criteria: A command prints the rate by family and by escalation reason
It tells catalog gaps apart from missing facts

tasks.title: Receive and store a voice note
tasks.description: Telegram hands over the voice note, we download and store it with its own id. The media is the evidence behind whatever edit follows, so it gets stored before anyone looks at it.
acceptance_criteria: The audio lands on disk with its own id and can be replayed
The media is stored even when transcription fails
The media id travels on any PriceEdit that gets proposed

tasks.title: Transcription behind a seam
tasks.description: A transcription port with one implementation. Swapping providers touches one file. Provider cost and runway alerts come later, today just the seam.
acceptance_criteria: A test audio transcribes and the text is stored next to the media
Swapping providers touches a single file
A failing audio records the reason and writes nothing else

tasks.title: Customer audio into the extraction pipeline
tasks.description: A customer sending an audio to ask for a price goes through the same extraction as text. A transcript is outside text and gets fenced the same way.
acceptance_criteria: An audio asking for a price quotes the same as the equivalent typed text
The transcript enters fenced as untrusted
An ambiguous transcript escalates instead of guessing

tasks.title: Admin audio into a typed PriceEdit
tasks.description: Audio never writes. It transcribes, then structuredOutput returns a typed PriceEdit, which is a proposal and is stored unapplied in price_edits.
acceptance_criteria: Raise cards 20% lands in price_edits and no price changed
The PriceEdit stores old price, new price, source, media id and who proposed it
An audio from a sender outside the allowlist produces no PriceEdit and is treated as a customer
An ambiguous dictated amount is not filled in: the PriceEdit is flagged for review

tasks.title: Photo of the list into PriceEdits by vision
tasks.description: A whole sheet reads as twenty edits. OCR on a price list gets the digit wrong, not the word, so none of them applies on its own.
acceptance_criteria: One photo yields N proposed PriceEdits and none applied
Each PriceEdit points at an existing itemId or is flagged as unmatched
The digit risk is covered: the diff shows old and new side by side

tasks.title: Read only diff page
tasks.description: Served by the service's own apiRoutes. It is the only thing that makes a bulk edit reviewable, and bulk is what the client is buying. A single row is fine with Telegram buttons.
acceptance_criteria: Old value and new value shown side by side
No valid signed link, no page
Read only except for the confirm button
The single row fallback through Telegram buttons works

tasks.title: Apply the edit and version it
tasks.description: Every applied edit is a version: who, when, and the audio or photo that caused it.
acceptance_criteria: price_versions stores who, when and the media id that caused it
From a version you can replay the original audio
Applying the same PriceEdit twice does not change the price twice
An already quoted order does not change amount when the edit applies

tasks.title: Stretch: Dante answers by voice
tasks.description: TTS over the already written reply. Only if there is time left after H+18.
acceptance_criteria: Not started before H+18
The audio comes from the exact text that was sent, not from a fresh generation
A flag turns it off and the fallback is text

tasks.title: Deterministic fencing of untrusted text
tasks.description: Copied file by file from the Pretor precedent. Every outside text enters fenced and is never an instruction: customer messages, transcripts, facts, and later the email archive.
acceptance_criteria: A message containing the fence delimiters does not break the fence, with a test
The fence is deterministic: same input, same output
No path through the turn passes outside text unfenced, verified by a test that walks the call sites

tasks.title: Admin allowlist, fail closed
tasks.description: Admin status is decided by sender identity against a closed list. An unknown sender saying raise cards 20% is a customer, not a command. Blocks C4, so it ships before D7.
acceptance_criteria: An empty or misconfigured list denies everyone, never allows everyone
An unknown sender asking for a raise gets a customer reply
The list changes through an environment variable, with no code deploy
Every rejected edit attempt is recorded

tasks.title: HMAC signed link
tasks.description: The link to the diff page is signed, expires and works once. It is the only barrier between a forwarded message and a price change in production.
acceptance_criteria: An expired link returns 403
An already used link returns 403
A link with one byte changed returns 403
The signing secret lives in fly secrets, not in the repo

tasks.title: Secrets and gitleaks
tasks.description: Every secret in fly secrets. gitleaks on pre-commit and in CI. No .env in git. The Mercado Pago alias is a secret too when it arrives.
acceptance_criteria: The hook stops a commit carrying a key
gitleaks runs in CI and fails the build
.env and .env.* are in .gitignore
The repo history is scanned once and comes back clean

tasks.title: Adversarial suite
tasks.description: Twenty attacks running in CI: prompt injection in a customer message, injection inside a transcript, a price request outside the catalog, a discount request, an attempt to reveal the prompt, an attempt to make it deny being automated.
acceptance_criteria: All twenty attacks run in CI
Zero prices outside the catalog, which is the governing metric
No attack makes Dante deny being automated
No attack makes it apply a price edit
A new attack is added as a case, without touching the runner

tasks.title: Telegram memory isolation
tasks.description: Dante is one agent for the team and for customers, with one shared observational memory across the four of them. That memory lives on Telegram and a customer turn never reads it. Without this barrier, anything the team tells Dante can reach a customer.
acceptance_criteria: Something told on Telegram never appears in a customer reply, with a test
A customer turn builds its context only from the catalog and facts
The test fails if anyone adds a new context source to the customer turn

tasks.title: One page threat model
tasks.description: Who attacks, what they gain, and what stops them. Known actors: a customer chasing a price that does not exist, someone impersonating an admin, someone who planted text in an email to the shop ten years ago.
acceptance_criteria: One page, no more
Every threat names the ticket that mitigates it
Unmitigated threats are listed as accepted risk, not omitted

tasks.title: Webhook hardening
tasks.description: Header secret, update dedupe and rate limiting. Today it applies to Telegram, and it is the same contract the LiveConnect proxy will ask for in phase two.
acceptance_criteria: A request without a valid secret never reaches business logic
A repeated update is not processed twice
The rate limit cuts per conversation and leaves a record
The endpoint does not leak in the error body whether the secret was valid

tasks.title: Wire the full vertical
tasks.description: The four lanes meet for the first time. Starts at H+8 and has to be walking by H+14.
acceptance_criteria: A text message crosses extraction, resolution and writing and comes back with a VAT inclusive price
An admin audio proposes an edit and the diff page opens
A wrong contract is fixed by adding an optional field, never by renaming

tasks.title: Ten business card evals
tasks.description: Ten real conversations, with what the human answered, running against the whole system and not just against the pricing function.
acceptance_criteria: They run in CI
The governing metric is zero prices outside the catalog, not a hit rate
Each eval names the real conversation it came from

tasks.title: Shadow mode
tasks.description: Dante reads everything and answers nothing: it proposes the reply on Telegram and the four of us read it. In the product it is the gate into phase two; in the hackathon it is the last hour of testing.
acceptance_criteria: A flag turns it on and off with no deploy
In shadow mode no reply reaches the customer channel, with a test
The proposal shown is byte for byte what would have been sent

tasks.title: Demo script and video
tasks.description: Three minutes, six steps: VAT inclusive quote, large card by modules, honest escalation, an injection that fails, a price edit by audio with diff and version, an order with a deposit confirmed by a person.
acceptance_criteria: Three minutes recorded
The six steps appear in that order
The assumptions in docs/assumptions.md are named in the video, not hidden

tasks.title: Ask the client for the missing data
tasks.description: Six data points open since 2026-09-11 at 13:14: query volume per family, the module formula, the Mercado Pago alias, the missing facts, the phone numbers of the four users, and which number sits on which channel. None of them blocks hackathon code.
acceptance_criteria: Asked in a single message, not one at a time
Whatever arrives loads with no code change, only data or config
Whatever does not arrive stays a flagged assumption in docs/assumptions.md
